title.ja: 真3D 1/r FMM：多段変換・力・適応所有権
title.en: Actual3D1/r FMM: multilevel translations, force and ownership

summary.ja: 非圧縮Chebyshev FMMを真の葉レベル2/3と別の適応配置で実行し、独立直接和のポテンシャル・加速度と比較します。
summary.en: Run uncompressed Chebyshev FMM at actual leaf levels2/3 and a separate adaptive configuration; compare independent direct potentials and accelerations.

assumptions.ja: 孤立重力-Gm/r、G1、64等質量、p3/5/7。主木は深さ強制、適応木のみcapacity8/maxdepth3。
assumptions.en: Isolated-Gm/r,G1,64equal masses,p3/5/7. Main levels forced; adaptive case alone usescapacity8/maxdepth3.

algorithm.ja: P2M/M2M/M2L/L2Lと局所基底の物理勾配、近接P2P。全非自己対を一意に割当て、非零の全変換経路を記録。
algorithm.en: Actual upward/downward translations, physical local-basis gradients and near P2P; audit unique nonself ownership and nonzero complete translation contributions.

validation.ja: 有限6点閉形式、独立Cartesian直接和、次数/実深さ、混合深さ・cap粒子保持、剛体変換を別確認。
validation.en: Separate finite6source exact goldens, independent Cartesian sums, order/actual-depth comparisons, mixed-depth capped ownership and rigid transformation.

limits.ja: 小Nの非圧縮教材。p^6 M2Lコストを保存し、SVD圧縮・球調和・Nスケーリング・運動量厳密保存は主張しません。 有限6点閉形式は独立directの資格確認で、FMM本体のgolden-target実行ではありません。
limits.en: Small-N uncompressed teaching example; reportp^6M2L cost. No SVD/spherical-harmonic/scaling or exact momentum-conservation claim. The finite6source exact probe qualifies the direct reference, not a production-FMM golden-target run.

references.title: The black-box fast multipole method
references.review_scope: Tensor interpolation Eq7 and multilevel stages sections2–3 inspected, printed8715–8717; compression is separate. Original uncompressed educational implementation here, no timing reproduction.

references.title: FMM3D mathematical definitions
references.review_scope: Official potential+1/(4pi r), gradient and source-self convention inspected. Our gravitational kernel is-1/r; FMM3D is not installed or run.

caption.ja: 固定入力を実際に計算した保存配列からの検証図。
caption.en: Validation figure from actual saved fixed-input calculation arrays.
